words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) opens the ayah as the named subject of a verbless equation. Its proper-name definiteness blocks a generic deity-class reading, while the shared definiteness and final u cadence balance the following definite predicate, {{ar:ٱلصَّمَدُ}} ({{tr:aṣ-ṣamad}}), as a matched two-noun frame. The repeated name also resets the boundary after 112:1: the prior pointing is resolved into explicit naming, and the clause launches without a connector or command marker. Against expanded variant formulae, the standard subject slot stays compressed into one fixed and highly recognizable name before the rare predicate arrives. The debated worship, bewilderment, and refuge background remains a narrowed resonance, because the local sense is the fixed name; it matters here by aligning the one sought in orientation with the title toward which need is directed.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّمَدُ}} ({{tr:aṣ-ṣamad}}) completes the two-word equation as a definite singular predicate-title, not a loose adjective or generic class property. Its grammar is decisive because case alone could also fit an attributive reading; the clause needs a predicate, and this word supplies it without a verb or qualifier. The title gathers several supported pressures at once: needs move toward the relied-on one as a recognized center of recourse and authority, the one named is self-sufficient in return, and the hard raised no-hollow image becomes a metaphysical statement of non-lack, indivisibility, and freedom from intake dependence. The surface noun also matters: it names the destination and settled title rather than narrating aiming, hardening, endurance, or becoming hard as a process, so firmness and endurance remain background pressures on inherent identity. Against expanded variant forms, the standard reading lets the title arrive immediately after the name, and the bare two-element equation contracts the definition from 112:1 into this predicate. Its hapax status, final position, al-plus-u reprise with {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}), final -ad rhyme with 112:1, and doubled onset make the predicate feel sealed, while the next ayah unfolds one part of its self-sufficiency by negating generation in 112:3.

topics.reason: Definiteness and nominative case could support an attributive parse, but the attachment layer marks the predicate relation as syntactically forced.

topics.headline: al-marked singular noun becomes a title

topics.reason: The local form is singular, definite, nominative, and without tanwin, and the word table explicitly warns that the article marks the title rather than a mere quality.

topics.headline: need moves one way toward the self-sufficient

topics.reason: V4 accepts the branch of intending and resorting to the relied-on one, and local predication lets that dependence relation define the named subject.

topics.headline: solid no-hollow image becomes metaphysical

topics.reason: V4 accepts the compact-solidity branch, including hard or elevated ground and solid compactness without hollowness; this supports the physical image while local predication turns it into theological description.

topics.headline: recognized center of recourse

topics.reason: The accepted resort branch includes the chief or relied-on one to whom affairs and needs are directed, so mastery and recourse can survive with the predicate title.

topics.headline: settled noun absorbs process meanings
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah names a settled title and destination rather than narrating aiming, hardening, or becoming hard as an action.
topics.reason: Related verbal and derivative fields color the noun, but the local surface is a predicate noun-title, so process branches must be kept as background pressure rather than local actions.

topics.headline: endurance colors the title without changing its form

topics.reason: V4 accepts lasting endurance as a branch, but the local noun is not a reflexive becoming-hard or endurance process form.

topics.headline: expanded variants highlight immediate predication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how compressed the standard reading is: the title arrives immediately after the name instead of after a longer creedal expansion.
topics.reason: Variant pressure is retained as contrast, while the local Hafs surface remains a single immediate predicate.

topics.headline: single Quranic occurrence concentrates meaning

topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the root/form as a single occurrence with no recurring pair network, and V4 supplies lexical branches that must be evaluated through this local predicate.

topics.headline: predicate closes and bridges the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 112:2 land on the predicate-title, complete the oneness claim from 112:1, and prepare the generation negation of 112:3.
topics.reason: The title is the ayah-final predicate, and the CRITICAL boundary rows give concrete same-surah links to 112:1 and 112:3 without making those links override the local parse.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural contraction from proposition to bare equation as the second predicate gives content to divine oneness.
topics.reason: The local attachment evidence confirms that 112:2 is only subject plus predicate, allowing the boundary claim about contraction from 112:1 to survive.

topics.headline: compressed sound reinforces the no-hollow image

topics.reason: The sound observations can reinforce the accepted solidity image, but they are narrowed because articulation alone does not establish lexical meaning.

topics.headline: local reprise and rhyme bind the definition

topics.reason: The article assimilation, final nominative cadence, and 112:1 rhyme link are compatible with the forced predicate relation and add formal reinforcement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The nominal predicate الصمد is attached directly to the named divine referent الله.
baseline_models.mechanism: The worshipped referent and the one intentionally resorted to combine into a directed dependency structure: affairs and needs move toward this referent and terminate in reliance there rather than being passed onward.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped one supplies the relational pole that the predicate identifies more precisely.
Intentional resort to a relied-on one supplies the directed motion and makes that pole the endpoint for affairs and needs.

changed_reading.before: Allah bears an honorific meaning roughly 'the self-sufficient lord.'
changed_reading.after: Allah is presented functionally as the terminal destination of directed need and reliance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same predicate الصمد carries a concrete image of compact solidity without hollowness.
baseline_models.mechanism: A material analogy overlays the social image of a relied-on chief: dependability is pictured as compact integrity with no cavity or internal lack through which support would have to be received. The analogy concerns structure, not divine anatomy.

activation_trace.role: The fixed divine name holds the concrete analogy to this particular referent rather than to an unnamed solid object.
Compact, non-hollow solidity supplies the image of integral support that does not depend on filling an inner lack.

changed_reading.before: The predicate says only that others seek or depend on Allah.
changed_reading.after: Their dependence terminates in one pictured as integrally full: support is not obtained by first repairing an interior deficiency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root ص م د in الصمد also supplies the concrete operation of tightly stopping a bottle.
baseline_models.mechanism: By material analogy, the predicate does more than name a destination: it marks closure. Resort reaches one capable of containing an affair and stopping leakage or indefinite referral beyond that point.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped referent supplies the personal pole to which the sealing image is predicated.
A tight stopper supplies containment and closure, functioning as an analogy for an affair that does not leak into further dependencies.

changed_reading.before: The sought destination is simply the highest point in a chain of recourse.
changed_reading.after: The predicate pictures the point at which recourse is sealed and the chain of referral closes.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The branch of الصمد involving continued endurance under severity remains attached to the divine predicate.
baseline_models.mechanism: Dependability becomes tested continuity rather than static permanence: the branch's creature enduring cold and drought while continuing its yield makes الصمد evoke support that does not cease when conditions become scarce or severe.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped one supplies the recipient of dependence whose reliability is being characterized.
Lasting through cold and drought while continuing provision supplies resilient continuity as the reason reliance holds under pressure.

changed_reading.before: Allah is permanently present as an abstract invariant.
changed_reading.after: Allah's permanence is read dynamically as support whose continuance is not exhausted by adverse or barren conditions.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predicate الصمد retains a branch for being poised over an affair and occupied with it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch changes the relied-on endpoint from remote rank into attentive proximity: an affair brought to the Samad is pictured as already under concentrated regard at its threshold.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped referent anchors the otherwise idiomatic image as a claim about the divine relation to an affair.
Being on the verge of an affair and occupied with it supplies attentive immediacy to the endpoint of recourse.

changed_reading.before: The predicate names a remote superior approached by petitioners.
changed_reading.after: The approached one is also pictured as attentively poised over the affair for which recourse is made.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to speak activates saying as both indication and delimiting definition. The compact nominal equation in 112:2 therefore functions not only as information but as a publicly uttered boundary for where reliance is to terminate.

activation_trace.role: A thing's 'saying' as its indication makes the commanded utterance point beyond sound to the relation asserted in the focus.
Saying a thing as defining its limit makes the utterance set a conceptual boundary around the focus predicate.
Resort to the relied-on destination supplies the relation that the spoken definition publicly fixes.

structural_cues: 112:1 opens with an imperative of speech immediately before the verbless two-term predication in 112:2.
The focus ayah's brevity lets the commanded utterance operate like a formula rather than a narrative description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commanded speech, indication, definition, and directed resort. I infer that utterance performs boundary-setting for reliance. A live alternative is that the command merely reports a proposition and adds no performative force.

changed_reading.before: Allah al-Samad is a private descriptive proposition about divine status.
changed_reading.after: Allah al-Samad is also a commanded public definition that fixes the endpoint of recourse in speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repetition of the same divine name across 112:1 and 112:2 creates a tight referential bridge: the worshipped one just identified is precisely the one now predicated as the destination of resort, preventing الصمد from drifting into a generic class of chiefs.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped referent is introduced in the preceding equation and supplies the repeated identity carried into the focus.
The destination relied upon supplies the new relation predicated of that repeated referent.

structural_cues: The exact proper name recurs in adjacent ayat, each time in a short nominal predication.
The second occurrence replaces the preceding predicate أحد with الصمد while retaining the subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated named worshipped referent and a resorted-to predicate. I infer deliberate coreference that excludes a merely generic 'reliable chief.' A live alternative is simple rhetorical repetition without this narrowing effect.

changed_reading.before: Al-Samad could denote a high but generic type of dependable lord.
changed_reading.after: The predicate is locked to the same named worshipped referent identified immediately before it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Unity before the focus and exhaustive negation at the close reshape resort into a topology of convergence: many affairs can be directed, but they do not terminate at several coordinate destinations. The one endpoint is also left without any residual competing instance.

activation_trace.role: Oneness and unity supply a single pole toward which the focus predicate's directed resort can converge.
Exhaustive negation removes any leftover instance that could serve as a coordinate endpoint.
Intentional resort supplies the many directed paths whose convergence is reorganized by the two context occurrences.

structural_cues: The focus is preceded by أحد as a positive predicate and the sequence closes with أحد inside a negated counterpart construction.
The two occurrences bracket the focus with positive singularity and exhaustive exclusion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unity, exhaustive negation, and directed resort. I infer a many-paths-to-one-endpoint structure. A live alternative is that unity and resort remain independent predicates with no spatial or network relation.

changed_reading.before: Al-Samad is one dependable option distinguished by supreme rank.
changed_reading.after: Al-Samad configures recourse as convergence on one endpoint with no coordinate remainder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The counting-and-composition branch of أحد presses the compact, non-hollow image of الصمد into a mereological question. Read against asserted unity and final exhaustive negation, compactness can suggest integrity not assembled from independently sustaining pieces.

summary.what_was_special: The one-word predicate sustains social, spatial, material, temporal, and causal readings at once. Its least expected live activations were closure by sealing, provision continuing under scarcity, attentive proximity to an affair, split-root load-bearing independence, and an unturnable trajectory of recourse.

The split-root, head-binding, sealing, and turning models should remain marked exploratory even though each is packet-anchored.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The One is the resorted-to center of need, but without reciprocal dependency.** Lexical evidence: `ص م د B001` (intending/resorting to the relied-on one), `ء ل ه B001` (worship and the worshipped one), `ء ل ه B002`, and 112:0 `ر ح م B001` (beneficence toward one shown mercy). Structural cue: `ٱللَّهُ` is repeated from 112:1 and immediately predicated as `ٱلصمد`; the basmalah's mercy precedes this, while 112:3-4 deny filial and peer relations. Assigned roles: `الصمد` supplies the direction of approach and reliance; `الرحمن الرحيم` supplies benevolent reception; the negations block any reading in which the relied-on One needs offspring, parent, or counterpart. Abductive move: I supply the asymmetry: creatures may direct need toward the relied-on One, but the local denials make that direction non-reciprocal. Reading change: 112:2 reads not merely as a title, but as a dependency map: all resort terminates there, while no genealogical or equalizing dependency returns.

2. **Compact solidity without hollowness activates the anti-birth reading.** Lexical evidence: `ص م د B002` (compact solidity without hollowness), `ص م د B003` (tight bottle stopper/seal), `و ل د B003` (birth/delivery), and `ر ح م B003/B004` (womb; afterbirth distress). Structural cue: `الصمد` stands immediately before the doubled negated birth verbs in 112:3. Assigned roles: compactness/no-hollowness supplies a material image of no internal cavity or reproductive aperture; the stopper variant intensifies sealing/closure; `لم يلد ولم يولد` states the relational denial. Abductive move: I infer a material analogy from `صمد` to the birth negation: the packet supplies solidity/no hollow and denied birth; I supply the image of generative passage being impossible or irrelevant. Reading change: `الصمد` reads as ontological fullness that makes begetting/being begotten incoherent, not just as "the one asked for."

3. **Endurance under severity recasts mercy as stable provision rather than soft dependence.** Lexical evidence: `ص م د B007` (lasting endurance and continuance; enduring cold/drought while continuing milk), `ر ح م B001` (tenderness/beneficence), and `ك و ن B001` (being/occurrence across time). Structural cue: the basmalah's mercy comes before, `الصمد` stands as central predicate, and 112:4 negates any occurring counterpart. Assigned roles: `صمد B007` provides continuity under harshness; mercy provides beneficent orientation; `يكن` later supplies the temporal/existential field in which no equal ever occurs. Abductive move: I infer that durable benevolence is locally stronger than affective softness alone: mercy is carried by an enduring, non-contingent support. Reading change: 112:2 allows `الصمد` to color the merciful names as steadfast provision that remains under need and pressure.

4. **The addressed worshipped One is not a chief among chiefs.** Lexical evidence: `ص م د B001` includes a chief/master sought for affairs, `ق و ل B004` includes a titled chief whose word has force, `س م و B007` includes rivalry/boasting, and `ك ف ء B001` later denies equal counterparts. Structural cue: the surah moves from `قل` to `الله الصمد` and then to denials of lineage and peer. Assigned roles: the social "chief sought in need" branch gives `الصمد` a recognizable hierarchy; the later denials strip hierarchy of competitive succession, lineage, and matching peers. Abductive move: I infer that the packet first permits a social analogy for intelligibility, then immediately breaks its ordinary social conditions. Reading change: `الصمد` may be read through lordly resort, but not as membership in a ranked political or tribal order.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 112:3 unexpectedly activated the material branch `ص م د B002`: after reading the birth negations, "compact solidity without hollowness" became central rather than decorative. 112:4 then expanded `الصمد B001`: if all resort moves toward the relied-on One and no `كفو` exists, the reliance is structurally one-way, not a mutual exchange between peers. The basmalah also became more relevant in hindsight: `ر ح م B001` allowed `الصمد` to be read as enduring beneficent support, not bare hardness.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The terminal direction of dependence.** Fixed-ayah `ٱلصَّمَدُ` is directly anchored in `ص م د:B001` (intending and resorting to the relied-on one), while `ٱللَّهُ` carries `ء ل ه:B001` (the worshipped one). The nominal identification places the object of worship and the destination of needs in one subject; 112:4's negated `ك ف ء:B001` removes any equal alternative destination. Worship supplies orientation, resort supplies directed movement, and lack of a counterpart prevents that movement from branching toward a peer. The causal arrow is inferred: the packet does not say that incomparability causes exclusive resort. The ayah now reads as a directional map of dependence, with `ٱلصَّمَدُ` as the endpoint on which need terminates.

2. **Compact integrity outside generative derivation.** The fixed title also activates `ص م د:B002` (compact solidity without hollowness). Immediately afterward, 112:3 repeats `و ل د` in active and passive directions; its `و ل د:B005` extends birth imagery to something generated or derived from something else, and both directions are negated. Solidity supplies the role of internal compactness, while the birth reversal supplies a source-product relation that fails in either direction. The exploratory abductive move is that derivation would introduce an origin/product differentiation that the material image of compactness resists; that implication is not explicitly stated by the packet. `ٱلصَّمَدُ` can therefore read as undivided and underived integrity, not as literal bodily hardness.

3. **A seal across both lineage directions.** Fixed-ayah `ص م د:B003` contributes the material image of a tightly stopped bottle. Its position directly before `لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ` lets the following active/passive pair be modeled as two opposed channels, one outward and one inward. The stopper branch serves as closure; the packet supplies the adjacency and the two negated directions, while I supply the analogy that a seal blocks passage through both. On this reading, `ٱلصَّمَدُ` anticipates the next ayah as a condition sealed against issuing offspring or receiving origin through birth. This is a structural-material activation, not a claim that the title literally denotes a container.

4. **Enduring support rather than an event in succession.** Fixed-ayah `ص م د:B007` names lasting endurance and continuance. The later clauses are saturated with temporal structures: `و ل د:B003` describes birth events, and `ك و ن:B001` in `لَمْ يَكُنْ` concerns occurrence or presence in time. The enduring branch supplies continuity, while the later negations remove both entry into a birth sequence and the occurrence of an equal. I infer that one who remains the relied-on destination is not positioned as one generated event among successive events. `ٱلصَّمَدُ` thus shifts from a static title to enduring availability that is not produced, replaced, or matched within temporal succession.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 112:3's active/passive birth mirror unexpectedly activated fixed `ص م د:B003` as a seal across two opposed channels and sharpened `ص م د:B002` from generic hardness into exploratory underived integrity. Then 112:4's `ك و ن:B001` placed occurrence explicitly in time, making fixed `ص م د:B007` read retrospectively as continuance outside the sequence of generated events and possible peers.

findings.text: Dayanak oluşu, bütün ihtiyaç yönelişlerinin Allah'ta son bulduğu, fakat Allah'ın da bir başkasına yönelen karşı bağımlılığının bulunmadığı tek yönlü bir ilişki kurar.
Dayanak niteliği, bedensel bir sertliği değil, doğum veya türeme yoluyla parçalara ayrılmayan, iç boşluğu bulunmayan bütünlüğü de çağrıştırır.
Sıkıca kapatılmış olma çağrışımı, sonraki ayette doğumun dışarı ve içeri yönlerinin birlikte kapanmasını önceden haber veren bir mühür gibi işler.
Dayanaklık, değişen koşullarda süren ve doğumla başlayan zamansal olaylar dizisinin parçası olmayan kalıcı bir destek olarak belirginleşir.
Kendisine başvurulan üstün kişi benzetmesi anlaşılmayı kolaylaştırır, ancak sonraki soy ve denklik olumsuzlamaları Allah'ı rakipleri ve halefleri bulunan önderler sınıfından çıkarır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem şişenin ağzını kapatan tıkacı hem de şişeye bu parçayı takarak ağzını kapatma eylemini verir. Verilen çerçeve nesne ile ona bağlı işlemi doğru biçimde bir arada, ancak ayırt edilebilir olarak tutar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca şişenin ağzındaki kapatma parçasına ve bu parçayla kapatma işlemine bağlıdır; genel kapatma, katılık veya başı bezle sarma anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım şişe tıkacı adını, şişeyi bu tıkaçla kapatma kullanımından ayırır; işlem anlamı bağımsız bir genel kapatma fiili sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Şişenin ağzına geçirilen ve içeriği dış etkilerden koruyarak ağzı kapatan tıkaçtır. Buna bağlı eylem, şişeye böyle bir tıkaç takıp ağzını kapatmaktır.

facets.statement: Şişenin ağzını sıkıca kapatan tıkaç ya da kapatma parçasıdır.
Şişeye bu kapatma parçasını takarak ağzını kapatma eylemidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar şişe ağzındaki tıkaç konusunda birleşir; aktarılan fiil kullanımı da şişeye bu parçayı takıp ağzını kapatmayı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da dar ağızlı bir kabın ağzını kapatan parçayı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal şişeye ve ona tıkaç takma işlemine bağlıdır; komşu dalın kap ve kuyu kapsamı daha geniştir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi başın bez, mendil veya kumaşla sarılmasını ve kullanılan sargı parçasını açıkça belirtir; sarığı ise özellikle dışarıda bırakır. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu işlem, araç ve dışlama sınırını doğru yansıtır.
